messages:
maria: quick heads-up: hit a weird parity bug in samplekit when using jsonMode + fncall tools on Node — retry path double-encodes function arguments.

sam: ouch. can you paste repro?

maria: repro steps: Node SDK v2.3.1, jsonMode: { strict: true }, tool returns { result: { id: 1, value: 'x' } }, then we spike an auth/network error so our retry wrapper kicks in. final received function_call.arguments is a stringified JSON containing another JSON string.

maria: example from logs:
```
request body: { function_call: { name: "parse_data", arguments: "{\"result\":\"{\\\"id\\\":1,\\\"value\\\":\"x\\\"}\"}" } }
```

sam: that looks like arguments got JSON.stringify'ed twice. do you hit schema validation failures?

maria: yes, our eval harness (expects object per schema) fails. behavior differs from Python sampleapp where retry path keeps object shape.

devex-bot: created ticket DEVEX-1427: "node sdk retry path re-stringifies fncall/tool args" (assigned: sam)

jordan: theory: retry wrapper serializes payload into cache/logs as a string, then we call JSON.stringify on the whole body again when rebuilding request. we also changed rawBody semantics in the http layer last month, might be related.

lee: quick mitigation for customers: set `jsonMode: { rawToolOutput: true }` or run `parseToolOutput(response)` in samplekit to coerce strings back into objects before schema validate. add to onboarding notes.

sam: i'll whip up a minimal repro and PR a fix in sdk-core: when retrying, preserve Buffer/string body but avoid re-stringifying function_call.arguments. adding unit + integration tests in samplekit.

maria: i'll add a failing integration test to our test matrix and update the samplekit onboarding docs to call out the retry caveat.

lee: lower-risk patch idea: detect `typeof function_call.arguments === 'string'` on the validate path and attempt a `JSON.parse`, but only if `jsonMode.strict` is enabled; emit telemetry if parse fails.

sam: good plan. will add opt-in telemetry flag so we don't silently mask issues. also add an explicit compatibility note for teams migrating between Node/Python SDKs.

jordan: fyi production teams: if you see sudden schema regressions after deploys, check for retry double-serialize first (esp. if you use jsonMode strict + fncall).

maria: thanks all! i'll follow up in the samplekit repo and docs. :thumbsup:
